svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Open box 205 x 140 x 95 mm outside, 1.0 mm sheet, folded from one

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cross-shaped blank by a sheet metal shop; TIG weld the four corners.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold a 5 mm flange inward all round the rim, last. It is the landing

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for the lid cold plate tray and must be flat within 0.3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cooling end wall: two riser slots 9 wide, 25 each side of centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: open at the rim and running down to 67.5 mm above the floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cable hole 6 mm, 40 toward the front, 86 up; fit a grommet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr every edge: the pouches must not be cut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: stands on the VIP floor panel; its walls touch the VIP walls.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the inside is 203 x 138 and square; the rim flange lies flat.
